subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept a postinstall loopback probe plus OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING as an advisory stale-gateway mitigation alongside the update-CLI warning work?
rationale: The code is review-clean, but install-time network probing, a new environment surface, and overlapping warning layers are product and operator-experience choices automation cannot settle safely.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
options.body: Merge this warning-only layer after maintainer review while keeping the canonical stale-gateway issue open for full recovery behavior.

options.title: Require Full Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal proof from a real package update or rollback with an already-running gateway before accepting the install-time probe.

options.title: Use One Warning Layer
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want only the update CLI or runtime stale-import handling to own the visible warning boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
recommendation.body: Merge this warning-only layer after maintainer review while keeping the canonical stale-gateway issue open for full recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has historical daemon path and postinstall-adjacent ownership signals, and this choice is primarily about product/operator policy rather than a narrow code defect.
